source: Everything we have is in the case mail. Open it.
text: Tutto quello che abbiamo è nella posta del fascicolo. Aprila.
note: lesson board-tour, beat 1/11 · difficulty 1 · goal: Open the case mail.

source: What came out of the envelope.
text: Quello che è uscito dalla busta.

source: Hold `Space` and drag. The board is wider than the screen.
text: Tieni premuto `Space` e trascina. La bacheca è più larga dello schermo.
note: lesson board-tour, beat 4/11 · difficulty 3 · goal: Look around the board.

source: Hold `Ctrl` and scroll. On a trackpad, pinch.
text: Tieni premuto `Ctrl` e scorri. Sul trackpad, pizzica.
note: lesson board-tour, beat 5/11 · difficulty 2 · goal: Zoom in and out.

source: This is your board. You can reach all of it.
text: Questa è la tua bacheca. Puoi raggiungerne ogni angolo.

source: The checkpoints, and where you are in them.
text: I checkpoint, e a che punto sei.
note: lesson board-tour, beat 8/11 · speaker Detective Reyes
lesson board-tour, beat 8/11 · speaker Detective Reyes · goal: The checkpoints, and where you are in them.

source: Every checkpoint on this file, up here.
text: Tutti i checkpoint di questo fascicolo, quassù.
note: lesson board-tour, beat 8/11 · speaker Detective Reyes · goal: The checkpoints, and where you are in them.

source: Every checkpoint, and the one you are on. The same brief you read in the window.
text: Ogni checkpoint, e quello in cui ti trovi. Lo stesso briefing che leggi nella finestra.
note: lesson board-tour, beat 9/11 · goal: The case file.

source: Your board holds more papers now. This shows the whole board.
text: Ora ci sono più carte sulla bacheca. Questo la mostra tutta.
note: lesson board-tour, beat 11/11 · difficulty 1 · goal: Frame the whole board.
